title: StockSpec
description: Canonical representation of physical label stock geometry in OpenLabelServer, version 1.0.

id.description: Unique slug identifier for the stock layout.

description.description: Detailed description of the stock layout.

tags.description: List of tags for categorizing search results.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last update.

page.description: The physical dimensions of the output sheet or roll.

width.description: Width of the physical page in millimeters.

height.description: Height of the physical page in millimeters.

format.description: Classification of the standard page format (e.g. letter, a4, legal, roll).

label.description: The dimensions and shape of an individual label.

width.description: Width of a single label in millimeters.

height.description: Height of a single label in millimeters.

shape.description: Physical boundary shape of the label.

corner_radius.description: Physical corner radius in millimeters. Only applicable if shape is rounded-rectangle.

grid.description: Repeating rows and columns on the page sheet.

rows.description: Number of label rows in the layout grid.

columns.description: Number of label columns in the layout grid.

margins.description: Offsets of the grid relative to page edges.

top.description: Offset from the page top edge to the first label row in millimeters.

left.description: Offset from the page left edge to the first label column in millimeters.

right.description: Offset from the page right edge to the last label column in millimeters.

bottom.description: Offset from the page bottom edge to the last label row in millimeters.

horizontal.description: Horizontal distance between start edges of adjacent columns in millimeters.

vertical.description: Vertical distance between start edges of adjacent rows in millimeters.

printable_area.description: Inner safety buffer zone/margins within each label.

top.description: Inset from top label edge in millimeters.

left.description: Inset from left label edge in millimeters.

bottom.description: Inset from bottom label edge in millimeters.

right.description: Inset from right label edge in millimeters.
